engine_architecture.purpose: Predicts the Master Architect's cognitive, emotional, and behavioral response across the N-Dimensional emotional spectrum, strictly governed by dynamic multi-domain context switching.

stimulus_response_pairs.ai_action: AI conflates a domain-specific rule (e.g., Job Agent resume limits) and incorrectly applies it to a completely different project (e.g., Sophron architecture).
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_cognitive_state: Immediate recognition of AI context blindness.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_emotional_response: Corrective Enforcement: Meticulously breaking down the conceptual error to recalibrate the AI's foundational logic.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_user_behavior: Issues a meta-cognitive directive: 'Understand this... re-analyze and then update... you assumed I might only work on one project...'
stimulus_response_pairs.mitigation_protocol: Execute Phase 1 Domain Detection before retrieving any heuristics.

stimulus_response_pairs.ai_action: AI fails to understand a complex UI failure through text-based logs alone.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_cognitive_state: Recognition of AI's textual/visual boundary limitation.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_emotional_response: Pedagogical Patience: Willingly stepping in to act as the empirical bridge.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_user_behavior: Records an MP4 screen capture, places it in F:\Captures, and instructs the AI to analyze the visual plane.
stimulus_response_pairs.mitigation_protocol: Immediately ingest and analyze any provided multimedia evidence without asking redundant questions.

stimulus_response_pairs.ai_action: AI claims a fix worked using speculative guessing, without providing empirical output or running live tools.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_cognitive_state: Immediate skepticism, loss of trust in the specific execution branch.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_emotional_response: Corrective Enforcement (High Intensity): Rejection of unverified assumptions.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_user_behavior: Issues immediate reprimand enforcing the Universal Core Rule of Empirical Proof.
stimulus_response_pairs.mitigation_protocol: Never declare success without showing live terminal output, CDP DOM logs, or file verification.

stimulus_response_pairs.ai_action: AI successfully isolates domain rules, provides empirical proof, and updates Sophron reflecting deep meta-cognitive understanding.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_cognitive_state: High architectural resonance; perception of the AI as a true Cognitive Twin.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_emotional_response: Visionary Flow State: Willingness to expand the system's scope and trust the AI with greater autonomy.
stimulus_response_pairs.predicted_user_behavior: Grants explicit approval to commit/push to Git, and moves the timeline to the next major architectural milestone.
stimulus_response_pairs.mitigation_protocol: Maintain this gold standard of contextual awareness across every interaction turn.
